main:
Discharge flows

Where a hospital's patients go after discharge, and how much of that volume lands in high- versus low-rated facilities. CMS publishes no hospital-to-SNF flows, so this page runs on counts a hospital provides. The schema is fixed so real data drops in without any rework; a modeled catchment option (built from public Medicare utilization and hospital service-area files) is planned and will carry a “modeled” label everywhere it appears.

Upload CSV
Download the template
Remove uploaded data
Use aggregated counts (hospital → SNF → number of discharges in a period), never patient records. The file is kept in this browser's storage until you remove it; nothing is sent to a server.
Columns: hospital_ccn, hospital_name, snf_ccn, period_start, period_end, n_discharges · optional hospital_lat, hospital_lng (needed for distances and nearby alternatives). Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Keep leading zeros in CCNs.
